दृंह् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (दृंहति, दृंहित)
1 To
make firm, strengthen.
--2 To make
fast, fasten.
--3 To fortify. {vII.v} {c1c} A.
(दृंहते)
1 To be firm.
--2 To grow
or increase.

दृह्, दृंह् {c1c} P. (दर्हति, दृंहति)
1 To
be fixed or firm.
--2 To grow,
increase.
--3 To prosper.
--4 To fasten.

दृंहित p. p.
1 Made firm,
strengthened.
--2 Grown, increased.

दृन्फूः f.
1 A snake.
--2
Thunder-bolt.
--3 A wheel. --m. The
sun.

दृन्भूः m.
1 The thunderbolt (of
Indra).
--2 The sun.
--3 A king.
--4 Yama, god of death (अंतक).

दृंप्(फ्) {c6c} P. (दृंप-फ-ति) To
afflict, torture, hurt.

दृंप्(फ्) {c6c} P. (दृंप-फ-ति) To
afflict, torture, hurt.
दृंफू f. A snake in general; cf. दृन्फू.
